risks.risk: Functional risk: no evidence of working condition; parts may be damaged (cracks, bent rods, seized turbo/valves, broken housings).
risks.proof: Photos of critical areas (cylinder head/block surfaces, any turbo/valve train components) and a video of any moving parts if applicable, plus compression/test report if the seller has it.

risks.risk: Condition/cleanliness risk: corrosion, oil sludge, or water damage may be present but not fully visible.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear/corrosion (worst case: needs refurbishment).
